shared.tagline.en: Know the wait before you walk in.
shared.tagline.text: Yeroo eegumsaa osoo hin seenin dura beeki.

shared.footer.copyright.en: © 2026 PickupRadar. Independent and not affiliated with Uber Eats, Deliveroo or Just Eat.
shared.footer.copyright.text: © 2026 PickupRadar. Of danda'aa, Uber Eats, Deliveroo yookaan Just Eat waliin hin hidhamne.

shared.scale.estimate.en: No recent reports? PickupRadar may show {likelyFast} or {likelySlow}:
shared.scale.estimate.text: Gabaasni haaraan hin jiru? PickupRadar {likelyFast} yookaan {likelySlow} agarsiisuu danda'a:

home.meta.title.en: PickupRadar (Pickup Radar): pickup wait times for delivery drivers in the UK
home.meta.title.text: PickupRadar (Pickup Radar): yeroo eegumsa fudhannaa konkolaachistootaaf Mootummaa Gamtooftuu keessatti

home.meta.description.en: See how long drivers wait at restaurants and shops before you go in. For Uber Eats, Deliveroo and Just Eat drivers in the UK. No sign-up needed.
home.meta.description.text: Osoo hin seenin dura konkolaachistoonni mana nyaataa fi dukkaana keessatti hammam akka eegan ilaali. Konkolaachistoota Uber Eats, Deliveroo fi Just Eat Mootummaa Gamtooftuu keessatti. Galmeen hin barbaachisu.

home.meta.imageAlt.en: PickupRadar. Know the wait before you walk in.
home.meta.imageAlt.text: PickupRadar. Yeroo eegumsaa osoo hin seenin dura beeki.

home.hero.lede.en: Do you deliver for Uber Eats, Deliveroo or Just Eat? See recent pickup waits at restaurants and shops. Avoid long waits. Tap {reportWait} and earn {radarPoints}. No sign-up needed.
home.hero.lede.text: Uber Eats, Deliveroo yookaan Just Eat tiif ni geessitaa? Bakka fudhannaa mana nyaataa fi dukkaana irratti yeroo eegumsaa haaraa ilaali. Eegumsa dheeraa irraa fagaadhu. {reportWait} tuqi {radarPoints} argadhu. Galmeen hin barbaachisu.

home.hero.cities.en: Now in Milton Keynes. London is next.
home.hero.cities.text: Amma Milton Keynes keessatti. Itti aansee London.

home.hero.apps.en: The iPhone and Android apps are coming soon.
home.hero.apps.text: Appilii iPhone fi Android dhiyeenyaan dhufu.

home.example.aria.en: Example PickupRadar Home screen with the {nearby} tab open, showing pickup points coloured by their wait
home.example.aria.text: Fakkeenya fuula jalqabaa PickupRadar, taabii {nearby} banamee. Bakkeewwan fudhannaa yeroo eegumsaatiin halluu qabu

home.example.banner.en: Example screen: sample waits, not live driver reports
home.example.banner.text: Fuula fakkeenyaa: yeroo eegumsa fakkeenyaa, gabaasa kallattii konkolaachistotaa miti

home.example.caption.en: Example screen. These are sample wait times, not live reports. {live} with real data.
home.example.caption.text: Fuula fakkeenyaa. Kun yeroo eegumsa fakkeenyaa, gabaasa kallattii miti. {live} odeeffannoo dhugaa waliin.

home.try.tab.en: {lead} Use {nearby} to find pickup points close to you when location is on. Use {fast} and {slow} to check waits and estimates.
home.try.tab.text: {lead} Bakki yoo baname bakkeewwan fudhannaa si dhiyoo jiran argachuuf {nearby} fayyadami. Yeroo eegumsaa fi tilmaama ilaaluuf {fast} fi {slow} fayyadami.

home.try.search.en: {lead} Try a name, area or postcode, like KFC or Bletchley.
home.try.search.text: {lead} Maqaa, naannoo yookaan koodii poostaa yaali, fakkeenyaaf KFC yookaan Bletchley.

home.try.open.en: {lead} The {reportWait} screen opens. Choose a wait time. Nothing is sent.
home.try.open.text: {lead} Fuulli {reportWait} ni banama. Yeroo eegumsaa filadhu. Wanni ergamu hin jiru.

home.signals.title.en: What you can see before you go in
home.signals.title.text: Osoo hin seenin dura wanta argitu

home.signals.intro.en: You see the same labels in the app. Drivers report them, not the delivery apps.
home.signals.intro.text: Appii keessatti mallattoo walfakkaataa ni argita. Konkolaachistoonni isa gabaasu, appii geejjibaa miti.

home.signals.current.body.en: Drivers choose a wait time. You see the current wait and how many drivers reported it in the last 2 hours.
home.signals.current.body.text: Konkolaachistoonni yeroo eegumsaa filatu. Yeroo eegumsaa ammaa fi sa'aatii 2 darban keessatti konkolaachistoonni meeqa akka gabaasan ni argita.

home.signals.likely.body.en: Shown only when there are no recent reports. These are estimates, not live reports.
home.signals.likely.body.text: Gabaasni haaraan yoo hin jirre qofa ni agarsiifama. Kun tilmaama, gabaasa kallattii miti.

home.signals.closed.body.en: Drivers tap {reportProblem} to report this. You see their report before you drive there.
home.signals.closed.body.text: Konkolaachistoonni kana gabaasuuf {reportProblem} tuqu. Achitti deemuu kee dura gabaasa ni argita.

home.how.intro.en: Three easy steps. Reporting takes a few seconds.
home.how.intro.text: Tarkaanfii sadii salphaa. Gabaasuun sekondii muraasa qofa fudhata.

home.how.step1.body.en: No password. The app gives you a Radar profile automatically. You don't need to sign up.
home.how.step1.body.text: Jecha iccitii hin jiru. Appiin piroofaayilii Radar ofumaan siif kenna. Galmaa'uun hin barbaachisu.

home.how.step2.body.en: Find the pickup point. See the current wait, or {likelyFast} or {likelySlow} if there are no recent reports.
home.how.step2.body.text: Bakka fudhannaa barbaadi. Yeroo eegumsaa ammaa ilaali, yookaan gabaasni haaraan yoo hin jirre {likelyFast} yookaan {likelySlow}.

home.how.step3.body.en: After you collect the order, tap {reportWait}. It takes seconds. Your report helps other drivers, and you earn {radarPoints}.
home.how.step3.body.text: Ajaja erga fudhattee booda {reportWait} tuqi. Sekondii muraasa fudhata. Gabaasni kee konkolaachistoota biroo gargaara, ati {radarPoints} argatta.

home.points.neededHelp.en: An eligible pickup point near you with no recent wait and no {likelyFast} or {likelySlow}. You earn 15 RP for the report instead of 10.
home.points.neededHelp.text: Bakka fudhannaa ulaagaa guutu si dhiyoo jiru, yeroo eegumsaa haaraa hin qabu, {likelyFast} yookaan {likelySlow} hin qabu. Gabaasa sanaaf 15 RP argatta, 10 miti.

home.cities.body.en: These are the UK cities in the app. Can't find your city? Request it in the app. Or tap {notify} on a {comingSoon} city. We'll email you when it's live.
home.cities.body.text: Kanneen magaalota Mootummaa Gamtooftuu appii keessaa dha. Magaalaa kee hin arginee? Appii keessatti gaafadhu. Yookaan magaalaa {comingSoon} ta'e irratti {notify} tuqi. Yeroo seenu imeelii siif ergina.

home.trust.title.en: Not part of any delivery app

home.trust.body.en: PickupRadar is independent. It is not part of Uber Eats, Deliveroo, Just Eat or any other delivery app. It never uses your accounts with them.
home.trust.body.text: PickupRadar of danda'aa dha. Uber Eats, Deliveroo, Just Eat yookaan appii geejjibaa biraa kamiyyuu keessaa miti. Akkaawuntii kee achitti gonkumaa hin fayyadamu.

home.trust.login.en: {lead} We never ask for your Uber Eats, Deliveroo or Just Eat username or password.
home.trust.login.text: {lead} Maqaa fayyadamaa yookaan jecha iccitii Uber Eats, Deliveroo yookaan Just Eat gonkumaa hin gaafannu.

home.trust.detailsLead.text: Bal'inni maamilaa yookaan ajajaa hin jiru.

home.trust.details.en: {lead} No names, addresses or order numbers.
home.trust.details.text: {lead} Maqaan, teessoon yookaan lakkoofsi ajajaa hin jiru.

home.faq.account.a.en: No. The app gives you a Radar profile automatically. You can report waits straight away. To protect your {radarPoints}, add your email later. No password needed. The app emails you a 6-digit code.
home.faq.account.a.text: Lakki. Appiin piroofaayilii Radar ofumaan siif kenna. Yeroo eegumsaa battalumatti gabaasuu dandeessa. {radarPoints} eeguuf booda imeelii dabaluu. Jecha iccitii hin jiru. Appiin koodii dijiitii 6 imeelii tiin erga.

home.faq.download.q.en: When can I download the app?

home.faq.download.a.en: The iPhone and Android apps are coming soon. For now, the {preview} shows real Milton Keynes pickup points and waits.
home.faq.download.a.text: Appilii iPhone fi Android dhiyeenyaan dhufu. Ammaaf {preview} bakkeewwan fudhannaa dhugaa fi yeroo eegumsaa Milton Keynes agarsiisa.

home.faq.track.a.en: No background tracking. The app uses your location while you use it, to show nearby pickup points and check you are at a pickup point when reporting. The website asks for location only when you choose to use it. Read the {privacy} for more.
home.faq.track.a.text: Hordoffiin duubaa hin jiru. Appiin bakka kee yeroo ati fayyadamtu fayyadama, bakkeewwan fudhannaa dhiyoo jiran agarsiisuuf fi yeroo gabaasa bakka fudhannaa irra akka jirtu mirkaneessuuf. Marsariitiin bakka gaafata yeroo ati fayyadamuu filattu qofa. Dabalataan {privacy} dubbisi.

app.meta.description.en: Try the PickupRadar app with real Milton Keynes data. Look around, search for pickup points and see the report screen.
app.meta.description.text: Appii PickupRadar odeeffannoo dhugaa Milton Keynes waliin yaali. Naannoo ilaali, bakka fudhannaa barbaadi, fuula gabaasaas ilaali.

app.hero.lede.en: This is PickupRadar with real Milton Keynes data. Look around. Search for a pickup point and open it. Nothing you tap here is sent. You can only report in the mobile app.
app.hero.lede.text: Kun PickupRadar odeeffannoo dhugaa Milton Keynes waliini. Naannoo ilaali. Bakka fudhannaa barbaadi baniis. Wanti asitti tuqxe hin ergamu. Appii bilbilaa qofatti gabaasuu dandeessa.

app.preview.aria.en: Full PickupRadar app preview with real Milton Keynes data
app.preview.aria.text: Ilaalcha guutuu appii PickupRadar odeeffannoo dhugaa Milton Keynes waliin

support.meta.description.en: Get help with PickupRadar: contact support, report a pickup point problem, and find answers about your Radar profile, {radarPoints} and deleting your account.
support.meta.description.text: Gargaarsa PickupRadar: deeggarsa qunnami, rakkoo bakka fudhannaa gabaasi, deebii waa'ee piroofaayilii Radar, {radarPoints} fi akkaawuntii haquu barbaadi.

support.hero.lede.en: Need help? Email us about the app, a pickup point, your {radarPoints} or your privacy.
support.hero.lede.text: Gargaarsa barbaaddaa? Waa'ee appii, bakka fudhannaa, {radarPoints} yookaan iccitii keetii imeelii ergi.

support.contact.body.en: Email us for help, ideas, pickup point problems or privacy questions:
support.contact.body.text: Gargaarsa, yaada, rakkoo bakka fudhannaa yookaan gaaffii iccitii tiif imeelii ergi:

support.address.note.en: For letters only. Email is the fastest way to reach us.
support.address.note.text: Xalayaa qofaaf. Nu qunnamuuf karaan saffisaa imeelii dha.

support.include.body.en: If you report a problem, please tell us:
support.include.body.text: Rakkoo yoo gabaasaa jirtan nuuf himaa:

support.include.area.en: The area or postcode, if you know it
support.include.area.text: Naannoo yookaan koodii poostaa, yoo beektan

support.include.phone.en: Your phone model, if the app has a problem
support.include.phone.text: Moodela bilbila keessanii, rakkoon appii yoo ta'e

support.topics.profile.body.en: The app gives you a Radar profile automatically. You do not need to log in to use PickupRadar or earn {radarPoints}. Adding your email is optional. It protects your {radarPoints} if you change or reset your phone. No password needed. The app emails you a 6-digit code.
support.topics.profile.body.text: Appiin piroofaayilii Radar ofumaan siif kenna. PickupRadar fayyadamuuf yookaan {radarPoints} argachuuf seenuun hin barbaachisu. Imeelii dabaluun filannoo dha. Bilbilli yoo jijjiiramte yookaan deebifamte {radarPoints} ni eega. Jecha iccitii hin jiru. Appiin koodii dijiitii 6 imeelii tiin erga.

support.topics.points.body.en: You earn {radarPoints} for valid wait reports ({waitRp}, or {neededRp} when it says {reportNeeded}), a first report bonus ({firstRp}) and pickup points we approve ({approvedRp}). You can invite a driver from {profile}. You both need protected Radar accounts (add your email). Your friend enters your code before their first valid wait report. When your friend makes 3 valid wait reports, on at least 2 different days (UTC time), at 2 different pickup points, you each earn {referralRp}. {rewards} You can't redeem {radarPoints} yet.
support.topics.points.body.text: Gabaasa eegumsaa sirrii tiif {radarPoints} argatta ({waitRp}, yookaan {reportNeeded} yoo barreeffame {neededRp}), badhaasa gabaasa jalqabaa ({firstRp}) fi bakka fudhannaa nu mirkaneessinu ({approvedRp}). {profile} irraa konkolaachisaa affeeruu dandeessa. Lamaan keessan akkaawuntii Radar eegumsa qabu barbaaddu (imeelii dabaluu). Hiriyyaan kee koodii kee gabaasa eegumsaa sirrii jalqabaa dura galcha. Hiriyyaan kee gabaasa eegumsaa sirrii 3 yeroo hojjetu, yoo xiqqaate guyyaa 2 adda addaa (yeroo UTC) irratti, bakka fudhannaa 2 adda addaa irratti, tokkoon tokkoon {referralRp} argata. {rewards} {radarPoints} amma fayyadamuu hin dandeessu.

support.topics.messages.body.en: {profile} has {messages}: announcements, alerts and personal messages for your city or Radar profile. Old or removed messages may no longer appear.
support.topics.messages.body.text: {profile} {messages} qaba: beeksisa, akeekkachiisa fi ergaa dhuunfaa magaalaa kee yookaan piroofaayilii Radar keetiif. Ergaan durii yookaan haqame deebi'ee hin mul'atu ta'a.

support.topics.delete.body.en: Delete your account in the app: {profile} → {deleteAccount}. Or email {email}. If you did not add an email, the app shows {deleteProfile} instead. See the {page} page for the steps.
support.topics.delete.body.text: Appii keessatti akkaawuntii haqi: {profile} → {deleteAccount}. Yookaan {email} tiif imeelii ergi. Imeelii yoo hin daballe appiin {deleteProfile} agarsiisa. Tarkaanfii fuula {page} ilaali.

support.topics.missing.body.en: Is a pickup point missing? Tap {suggest} in the app. Is one wrong? Tap {reportProblem}. Or email us and we will check it.
support.topics.missing.body.text: Bakki fudhannaa hin jiru? Appii keessatti {suggest} tuqi. Wanti dogoggoraa jiraa? {reportProblem} tuqi. Yookaan imeelii ergi, ni ilaalla.

support.topics.delivery.body.en: PickupRadar does not connect to your Uber Eats, Deliveroo, Just Eat or other delivery app accounts. We never ask for your delivery app logins, passwords, account details, customer details or order details. Drivers only share pickup reports, like wait times and pickup point problems.
support.topics.delivery.body.text: PickupRadar akkaawuntii kee Uber Eats, Deliveroo, Just Eat yookaan appii geejjibaa biraa kamiyyuu waliin hin hidhamu. Seenuu, jecha iccitii, bal'ina akkaawuntii, bal'ina maamilaa yookaan bal'ina ajajaa gonkumaa hin gaafannu. Konkolaachistoonni gabaasa fudhannaa qofa qoodu, akka yeroo eegumsaa fi rakkoo bakka fudhannaa.

support.closer.title.en: Try PickupRadar before the app launches.
support.closer.title.text: Appiin osoo hin baasin dura PickupRadar yaali.

support.closer.body.en: The live preview shows real Milton Keynes pickup points and waits. Reporting and {radarPoints} are only in the mobile app.
support.closer.body.text: Ilaalchi kallattii bakkeewwan fudhannaa dhugaa fi yeroo eegumsaa Milton Keynes agarsiisa. Gabaasuun fi {radarPoints} appii bilbilaa qofa keessa jiru.

notfound.meta.description.en: That page is not on the PickupRadar website.
notfound.meta.description.text: Fuulli sun marsariitii PickupRadar irratti hin jiru.

notfound.title.en: This page is off the radar.

notfound.body.en: That address isn't on the PickupRadar website. These pages are:
notfound.body.text: Teessoon sun marsariitii PickupRadar irratti hin jiru. Fuuloonni kun jiru:

privacy.notice.en: The summary and section headings are translated. The full privacy policy is in English, which is the official version.
privacy.notice.text: Cuunfaa fi mataduree kutaalee hiikamaniiru. Imaammanni dhuunfaa guutuun Afaan Ingiliziin jira, gosti Afaan Ingilizii immoo kan seera qabeessa dha.

privacy.h.collect.en: Information we collect and how we use it
privacy.h.collect.text: Odeeffannoo nuti sassaabnu fi akkaataa itti fayyadamnu

privacy.sum.what.en: PickupRadar helps delivery drivers see and report pickup wait times and venue problems.
privacy.sum.what.text: PickupRadar konkolaachiftoota geejjibaa yeroo eegumsaa fudhannaa fi rakkoolee bakkeewwanii akka arganii gabaasan gargaara.

privacy.sum.account.en: You can browse without creating an account. The app creates an anonymous Radar profile for your phone, and an email account is optional.
privacy.sum.account.text: Herrega malee sakatta'uu ni dandeessa. Appiin bilbila keetiif profaayilii Radar maqaa hin qabne uuma; herregni imeelii immoo filannoo dha.

privacy.sum.location.en: If you allow location, the app uses it while you are using it: to sort nearby pickup points, detect your city and check that you are at a venue when you submit a live report. We do not save your location with your reports.
privacy.sum.location.text: Yoo bakka akka beekamu hayyamte, appiin yeroo itti fayyadamtu qofa itti fayyadama: bakkeewwan fudhannaa dhiyoo jiran tartiibessuuf, magaalaa kee adda baasuuf, fi yeroo gabaasa kallattii ergitu bakka sana jiraachuu kee mirkaneessuuf. Bakka kee gabaasota kee waliin hin olkaa'innu.

privacy.sum.saved.en: Your saved pickup points stay on your phone.
privacy.sum.saved.text: Bakkeewwan fudhannaa ati olkaa'atte bilbila kee irratti hafu.

privacy.sum.noSale.en: We do not sell your personal information and the app contains no advertising or analytics trackers.
privacy.sum.noSale.text: Odeeffannoo dhuunfaa kee hin gurgurru, appiin hordoftoota beeksisaa ykn xiinxalaa hin qabu.

privacy.sum.delete.en: You can delete your Radar profile or account in the app, or ask us by email. See {link}.
privacy.sum.delete.text: Profaayilii Radar ykn herrega kee appii keessatti haquu ni dandeessa, ykn imeeliin nu gaafachuu dandeessa. {link} ilaali.

delete.meta.title.en: Delete your account or data — PickupRadar
delete.meta.title.text: Herrega ykn daataa kee haqi — PickupRadar

delete.meta.description.en: How to delete your PickupRadar account, Radar profile and associated data, including without the app.
delete.meta.description.text: Akkaataa herrega PickupRadar, profaayilii Radar fi daataa wal qabatu itti haqxu, appii malee illee.

delete.lead.en: This page explains how to delete your PickupRadar account, your Radar profile and the data linked to them, including if you no longer have the app. PickupRadar is developed by Hamza Khan.
delete.lead.text: Fuulli kun akkaataa herrega PickupRadar kee, profaayilii Radar kee fi daataa isaan waliin walqabatu itti haqxu ibsa, yoo appii sana kana booda hin qabaanne illee. PickupRadar kan hojjete Hamza Khan dha.

delete.app.step2.en: Tap {profile} at the bottom of the Home screen.
delete.app.step2.text: Bakka gadii fuula jalqabaa irratti {profile} tuqi.

delete.app.step3.en: Scroll down and tap {deleteAccount} if you protected your RadarPoints with your email, or {deleteProfile} if you did not.
delete.app.step3.text: Gara gadiitti sochoosiitii, yoo RadarPoints kee imeeliin eegde {deleteAccount}, yoo kanaa miti {deleteProfile} tuqi.

delete.app.after.en: Deletion starts straight away. Afterwards, the app starts a new anonymous Radar profile on your phone.
delete.app.after.text: Haqiinsi battaluma jalqaba. Sana booda appiin bilbila kee irratti profaayilii Radar maqaa hin qabne haaraa jalqaba.

delete.email.title.en: Ask us to delete your email account
delete.email.title.text: Herrega imeelii kee akka haqnu nu gaafadhu

delete.email.intro.en: If you protected your RadarPoints with your email address and cannot use the app:
delete.email.intro.text: Yoo RadarPoints kee teessoo imeeliitiin eegdee fi appii fayyadamuu hin dandeenye:

delete.email.step1.text: {from} gara {email} tti imeelii ergi, mata-duree “{subject}” qabu.

delete.email.from.en: from the email address on your PickupRadar account
delete.email.from.text: teessoo imeelii herrega PickupRadar kee irraa

delete.email.step2.en: We will reply to that address to confirm the request before deleting anything.
delete.email.step2.text: Waan tokko illee osoo hin haqin dura, gaaffii sana mirkaneessuuf teessoo sanatti deebii kennina.

delete.email.other.en: If you write from a different address, we will need to confirm that you control the account’s email address. We will never ask for a password or for a sign-in code. Do not send us your code.
delete.email.other.text: Yoo teessoo biraa irraa barreessite, teessoon imeelii herregaa to'annoo kee jala jiraachuu isaa mirkaneessuu qabna. Jecha icciitii ykn koodii seenii gonkumaa hin gaafannu. Koodii kee nuuf hin ergin.

delete.anon.p1.en: If you never added an email address, your Radar profile is linked only to a random ID stored in the app on your phone. The easiest way to delete it is in the app, using the steps above.
delete.anon.p1.text: Yoo teessoo imeelii gonkumaa hin dabalin, profaayiliin Radar kee ID tasaa appii bilbila kee keessatti olkaa'ame qofa waliin walqabata. Karaan salphaan ittiin haqxu appii keessatti, tarkaanfiiwwan armaan oliitiin dha.

delete.anon.p2.en: Deleting the app removes that ID from your phone, but it does {not} delete the records on our servers.
delete.anon.p2.text: Appii haquun ID sana bilbila kee irraa balleessa, garuu galmee sarvarii keenya irra jiru {not}.

delete.anon.p3.en: Ownership of an anonymous profile can only be proven from the phone it was created on, using the random ID and secret code stored in the app. Details such as a Radar name, a city or the dates you used the app can’t prove that a profile is yours, because other people could know them. So if you no longer have the app, we may not be able to delete an anonymous profile. You can still email {email} and we will explain what we can do.
delete.anon.p3.text: Abbummaan profaayilii maqaa hin qabne bilbila irratti uumame qofa irraa, ID tasaa fi koodii iccitii appii keessatti olkaa'ameen mirkanaa'uu danda'a. Bal'inni akka maqaa Radar, magaalaa ykn guyyoota appii itti fayyadamte, kan biroonis beekuu waan danda'aniif, profaayiliin kan kee ta'uu hin mirkaneessu. Kanaafuu yoo appii kana booda hin qabaanne, profaayilii maqaa hin qabne haquu dadhabuu dandeenya. Garuu ammas gara {email} tti imeelii erguu dandeessa, waan gochuu dandeenyu siif ibsina.

delete.alerts.body.en: You can withdraw a launch alert in the app, or email us from the address you signed up with and we will delete the sign-ups for that address. Launch-alert emails are also deleted automatically, as explained in our {privacy}.
delete.alerts.body.text: Beeksisa jalqabaa appii keessatti deebisuu dandeessa, ykn teessoo ittiin galmoofte irraa imeelii nuuf ergi, galmee teessoo sanaa ni haqna. Imeelonni beeksisa jalqabaa ofumaanis ni haqamu, akkuma {privacy} keenya ibsu.

delete.deleted.profile.en: Your Radar profile, Radar name, RadarPoints and contribution history
delete.deleted.profile.text: Profaayilii Radar kee, maqaa Radar, RadarPoints fi seenaa gumaachaa

delete.deleted.email.en: Your email sign-in, if you had an email account
delete.deleted.email.text: Seenii imeelii kee, yoo herrega imeelii qabaatte

delete.deleted.links.en: The links between your phone’s device ID and your profile
delete.deleted.links.text: Walitti hidhamiinsa ID meeshaa bilbila kee fi profaayilii kee gidduu jiru

delete.deleted.referrals.en: Your referral codes, and your read or dismissed status for in-app messages
